records.FullPageBody: Today’s New Moon in {{eventSign}} gives Mars a fresh place to put effort. A new target can be energizing, but the useful question is not only what you can start; it is what deserves enough force, time, and conflict to keep going.
records.FallbackBody: Today’s New Moon in {{eventSign}} gives Mars a fresh place to put effort.
records.ExactPhraseAnchors: New Moon begins a new cycle | beginnings require room for what comes next

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Full Moon across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} makes it easier to see what all the effort has been producing. Mars can keep pushing because there is still energy left, but culmination asks a different question: is the fight, workload, or pursuit still worth what it takes out of you?

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Solar Eclipse in {{eventSign}} can turn urgency into action before the full terrain is visible. Mars will happily move first; the eclipse makes it more important to know which limit you are defending and which reaction is simply faster than the information.
records.FallbackBody: Today’s Solar Eclipse in {{eventSign}} can turn urgency into action before the full terrain is visible.
records.ExactPhraseAnchors: Solar eclipse as a supercharged New Moon | new paths emerge while events are still unfolding

records.FullPageBody: Today’s Lunar Eclipse across {{eventSign}} and {{oppositeSign}} can bring a conflict, workload, or long-running push to a point where endurance is no longer the main skill. Mars shows where you can act; the eclipse shows where continuing the same fight would only repeat the cost.
